text:
jun: quick sync: we need a tiny orchestration layer (fanout-orchestrator) between proxy and region backends to control cross-region bursts and enforce residency.

lena: +1. two main goals: 1) policy enforcement (resident vs multi-region) 2) smooth degradations during region outages.

omar: proposal: orchestrator consults local policy cache (TTL 30s), returns decision: local-only, staged-fanout, or parallel-fanout. on cache miss -> 50ms call to policy-service -> default safe (local-only).

priya: for failover, avoid blasting all regions. use per-tenant rate limiter + jittered retry schedule. state machine per tenant-region: OK, THROTTLED, BLACKLISTED.

jun: observability: emit Fanout-Trace header like `ft=us-east;tenant=42;dec=staged;seq=8`. also log attempted regions and final served_region.

lena: operator controls: global gates to reduce fanout concurrency and an emergency override token (short-lived + audited). document runbook steps.

omar: metrics: fanout_attempts, policy_blocked, cache_hit_ratio, per-region_error_rate. also expose cost_estimate_tokens to Optimize.

priya: API sketch: POST /internal/orchestrate Headers: X-Fanout-Hint Body: tenant_id, model, request_id Response: decision, allowed_regions, cost_estimate_tokens. keep response tiny.

jun: next: I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagrams and failure-modes. nina/ops can prototype the jittered ramp and chaos tests. infra-bot please canary.

infra-bot: deploy: fanout-orchestrator v0.1 canary started in eu-west-1 at 1769600100.

lena: cool. aim for prototype + chaos harness in 2 weeks.

priya: I'll add tests for consent rejection and ensure fallback doesn't leak data.

jun: thanks all ":"
